reason: No independent human-rated risk scores (severity, specificity, or overall risk) exist in the repository.
weight_optimization_status: Not Performed. Weight optimization was not performed because independent scoring ground truth was unavailable.

c5_contract.marginal_risk_formula: Risk(Portfolio + Candidate) - Risk(Portfolio). Due to the additive nature of the baseline C4 formula, this equals Candidate Service Risk.
c5_contract.overlap_detection: Set intersection of portfolio canonical entities and candidate canonical entities.
c5_contract.new_entity_detection: Set difference of candidate entities minus portfolio canonical entities.
c5_contract.db_mutation_behavior: Candidate evaluation is performed strictly in-memory and does not mutate the real database.

mathematical_invariants_tested: Weight parameter behavior (w1/w2 changes alter output proportionally)
known_limitations: Absence of independent score labels prevents predictive evaluation (MAE, RMSE, accuracy).
Current overlap detection identifies shared entities but does not mathematically discount the marginal risk score (no discounting formula is currently specified in the project plan).
